			<rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4752"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3755">chos mngon po kun las btus pa</rs>'i rnams par bshad pa gsal ba blo'i rgyan</rs> zhes bya ba <lb n="180b3"/><note type="editorial">There's possibly a lost portion of the line.</note> chos dang gang zag po || || <note type="gloss">dag go |</note> bkra shis par gyur gcig | he he | </seg></TEI>
